blockers: RA-plugin planning PR #2 is open and unmerged; adoption is stacked on its exact head rather than treated as default-branch truth.

do_not_start: Second harness before OpenCode evidence meets the existing entry gate
GraphRAG, ontology, or universal coding governance
Confirmatory model runs before deterministic core/evaluator identities are frozen

decisions_not_to_reverse: OpenCode remains the first adapter and the core remains transport-neutral.
Research Assurance remains the authority for program-level methodology, benchmark interpretation, and scope decisions.
Ordinary research fails open while reviewed/accepted promotion fails closed when the required receipt is unavailable.
Hidden confirmatory labels, answers, seeds, and tasks remain outside implementer and evaluated-agent context.
PAM is methodology/config/schema/evidence-state for this adopter, not an RA-plugin runtime dependency.
open_questions: Which exact existing libraries or internal components can satisfy portions of the proposed deterministic RA core before bespoke implementation is authorized?
What exact public-development and later confirmatory dataset/manifests will bind the first OpenCode experiment?
What durable program-level decision-lineage record will distinguish proposed PR #2 architecture from owner-accepted architecture?

checks: Re-fetch RA-plugin issue #1, PR #2, the adoption PR, and relevant CI before implementation mutation.
Re-fetch Pukujan/research-assurance program state when scope, benchmark interpretation, or program architecture is implicated.
Verify the pinned PAM revision still resolves exactly before using its schemas or validators.
Treat merged/default-branch state as live truth and open PR content as proposals unless explicitly approved.

hidden_evaluation.policy: Confirmatory task manifests, labels, gold, perturbation seeds, and per-run hidden failure details are excluded from agent-visible handoff and implementation state; only the process boundary is recorded.
